items.title: Tor amplitude shifts by the tor dimension of a ring map of finite tor dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that viewing a complex of modules over an algebra of tor dimension at most d as a complex over the base ring shifts the lower end of its tor amplitude by d. The author notes that this is a special case of the general push-forward statement for tor amplitude and then gives a direct argument: a free resolution of a test module is tensored down, the derived tensor product over the base is rewritten as a derived tensor product over the algebra against the derived base change of the module, and since that base change has cohomology concentrated in a bounded range while the complex has tor amplitude in a given interval, the spectral sequence of the double complex shows the resulting cohomology is concentrated in the shifted interval.
